toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Compared headset-stand under demo-direct at 2026-10-24 for a target 30% revenue margin. Base recommended price is BRL 44.45; with no discount the charged price stays BRL 44.45 and revenue margin is 30.01%. With a 10% discount, charged price becomes BRL 40.01 and revenue margin drops to 23.35%, so the discount does not retain the requested margin.
assumptions: Product costs are synthetic demonstration data from demo-costs-v1, valid 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-26.
Channel rule is synthetic demonstration data from demo-rule-v1, with 10% revenue charge, BRL 2 fixed fee, and zero tax/advertising; no current marketplace claim.
All charges are treated on the common revenue basis used by the deterministic calculator.
Discount is applied to the calculated list price; pricing outputs are drafts only and require human approval.
limitations: Full-print retry assumption is included in the calculator, but real production failure behavior may differ.
Marketplace verification is not available; this is not a live Shopee fee check.
Demonstration inputs are synthetic and should not be used as confirmed business data.
